repository.name: webex-node
repository.purpose: Node.js build of the Webex JS SDK. Loading the package installs @babel/polyfill when no polyfill is present, loads 17 Webex plugin packages for their registration side effects, and exports WebexNode, a WebexCore subclass with a static init factory that merges sdkType 'webex-node', the package configuration object, and the caller's config before constructing an instance. The package configuration in src/config.js is currently nested under config.default and not applied.

public_interfaces.name: webex-node package export
public_interfaces.audience: Node.js applications; in this workspace the sibling package test-webex-node (manual smoke script)
public_interfaces.notes: module.exports is the WebexNode class; there are no named exports. Loading installs @babel/polyfill when global._babelPolyfill is not set and loads the 17 plugin packages listed in src/webex-node.js.

public_interfaces.name: WebexNode class and init factory
public_interfaces.notes: init merges {sdkType: 'webex-node'}, the src/config.js module object, and attrs.config into attrs.config (mutating attrs) and returns new WebexNode(attrs). Direct construction skips that merge. Plugin namespaces on instances are owned by the plugin packages.

public_interfaces.notes: The aggregate test script chains test:style and test:unit; run them separately. No integration or browser script exists.
